U001.function: Fires on contraction and possessive endings after an apostrophe (the s in 's, re in 're, t in n't) and on the second = of wiki heading markers.

U002.function: Fires on the word part right after an apostrophe in contractions and possessives ('re, 've, 's, 't), plus the h in km / h.

U003.function: Fires on the final = of a wiki section heading marker, and on mid-word fragments of rare names and long words (Rami, dega-ussing, Mus-well).

U004.function: Fires on the 's or 're suffix after an apostrophe, on the second byte of broken CJK characters, and on the word 'room' after 'engine'.

U005.function: Mixed: fires on the second = of section heading markers, on the word 'Factor' after 'The X', and on fragments of rare names (Petos-key, Cris-p).

U006.function: Fires on the middle or final piece of a split proper name or rare word (Shell-back, Sh-ima, touch-down), and sometimes on 'a' after 'was'.

U007.function: Fires on the unit or count noun after a number or quantity (rounds, long tons, half, jump) and on suffix pieces of long abstract words (-idity, -ative); also 'spell/points/stages' after a modifier.

U008.function: Fires on mid-word fragments of rare names and on 'Ten' after 'Big', and on the first digit of a chart number after 'number'.

U009.function: Fires on the next piece of a split first name or word right after a preceding name part (Jon Dol-, Jos-, Justin, touch-down) and on small function words like 'in' or 'around' after a verb.

U010.function: Fires on the hyphen or @ symbol in the @-@ hyphen pattern (scholar @-@, little @-@) and on the second = of heading markers.

U011.function: Fires on the @ symbol in @-@ or @.@ number/hyphen patterns, and on the first digit of a caliber number after 'calibre' (45-calibre [[3]]).

U012.function: Fires on the second @ of the @-@ hyphen pattern and on heading = markers, plus on middle fragments of rare names (Indoch-ina, Mei Yao-c).

U013.function: Mixed: fires on the second @ of @-@ after a word, and on mid-word pieces of names (Ky-ush-u, Saihok-ush) and on adverbs like 'temporary' or 'immediately'.

U014.function: Fires on the @ in decimal and hyphen patterns (3 @.@ 429) and on the second = of heading markers such as '= = Charts ='.

U015.function: Fires on connective function words that start an adverbial or link phrase (more broadly, into, for, as a result, most, In contrast, drawn from).

U016.function: Fires on the last piece of a split proper name, mostly a surname or place (Petos-key, Tiff-any, Pres-ley, Sh-ane, S-ich).

U017.function: Fires on the later pieces of split rare words and names (Mercen-aries, Don-key, rejo-ined, Ne-wn, Kim Ne-ely).

U018.function: Fires on the last token of a name or place phrase (Jocely-n, Simon Cow-ell, Arthur Hill, Bonin Islands, Chinese coast) and on broken CJK bytes.

U019.function: Fires on the hyphen after @ in @-@, on the second byte of broken CJK characters, on heading = markers, and on mid-word fragments (Pet-rol, gun-nery).

U020.function: Mixed: fires on the hyphen of @-@ patterns, on name fragments (K-ier, Baid-), and on closing parentheses after a date or measurement.

U021.function: Mixed: fires on the second = of heading markers, on suffix fragments (thatched, anthe-mic, a-irst), and on 'day' in 'late in the day'.

U022.function: Fires on the second = of heading markers and the hyphen of @-@ patterns, on broken CJK bytes, and on the noun 'capacity' or 'hang(ar)'.

U023.function: Fires on the hyphen in @-@ after a word and on middle or end fragments of rare names and words (Rid-ley, Yac-oub, solips-ism).

U024.function: Mixed: fires on word-final fragments (Cred-its, lab-oured, Val-erie, Bast-et) and on 'possible' after 'as ... as'.

U025.function: Fires on the last digit of a year, mostly the third or fourth digit of 3-digit and 4-digit years (75[[5]], 191[[3]]).

U026.function: Fires on the word 'been' or 'a' and similar helper words in the middle of a clause, and on some name endings (Cow-ell, H-ie).

U027.function: Mixed: fires on mid-word fragments of rare names and on adjectives or adverbs after 'was/very/too' (thin, late, supreme), and on digits in numbers.

U028.function: Fires on the third digit of a 4-digit year after '19' (19[[1]], 19[[3]]) and on the unit 'ft' after a number.

U029.function: Mixed: fires on the @ in numbers like 7 @.@ 62 (25 [[@]]), on 'more' or 'life' in loose phrases, and on word-end fragments.

U030.function: Fires on the unit word after a number in a measurement (metres, ft, feet, inches, m), mostly length.

U031.function: Fires on the @ in numbers like 53 @-@ and 7 @,@, and on the stem 'arm' (armour, armament) and the digit 9 in type numbers.

U032.function: Fires on verbs and nouns that continue a phrase after a subject (focusing, intention, reassess, themes), and on the @ in big numbers.

U033.function: Mixed: fires on word pieces in rare names (Her-ons, Mark St-ille, H-orthy) and on 'previously' or 'follows' after 'had' or 'as'.

U034.function: Mixed: fires on the unit or magnitude word after a number (metres, in, inches, million), on 'part' after 'In/As', and on the split name pieces Pred-yn and Anub-is.

U035.function: Mixed: fires on mid-word fragments (esc-orts, epit-he, Ed-fu, Battles-hip) and on words like 'top', 'dive', 'room' after an adjective.

U036.function: Mixed: fires on 'Factor' after 'The X', on 'more' after 'or', 'of' after 'a pair', and on end pieces of rare names.

U037.function: Fires on closing quote marks and apostrophes (a quotation mark or single quote right after a quoted word) and on the 's in possessives; also the second @ and 'ft'.

U038.function: Fires on the apostrophe or curly quote right after a word (Fu ', Teddy ', don ’) and on 'War' in 'World War', plus broken CJK bytes.

U039.function: Fires on a closing quotation mark or apostrophe after a quoted word, and on 's in possessives and plural -ars/-ima endings.

U040.function: Fires on a quote mark or apostrophe that closes or follows a quoted word (Kiss You ", Prince ', don ’), and on word-middle pieces like -ast, -od.

U041.function: Mixed: fires on the hyphen-@ in 'Ise @-@' headings, on the final piece of rare names (Z-aza, G-id, Nunn), and on shp.

U042.function: Mixed: fires on middle fragments of rare names and words (Arsen-al, Er-z, Merc-en) and on words like 'around', 'or', 'tubes' in mid-phrase.

U043.function: Fires on the second word of a multi-word proper name or noun phrase (green screen, Rockefeller Center, Rolling Stone, South Pacific, Crown Prince, Black Sabbath).

U044.function: Mixed: fires on mid-word fragments of rare names and words (ha-iku, RI-AA, Repulse, Har-p, break-out), and on broken CJK bytes.

U045.function: Fires on a word that introduces a name or description after a noun (named, called, titled, designated, consisted of, example of).

U046.function: Fires on the unit after a number in a measurement (ft, mm, cm, km, metres), especially length or gun caliber.

U047.function: Fires on the unit after a number in a measurement or speed (km, mph, ft, m, mi, metres); also on -ions in 'processions'.

U048.function: Fires on the unit word after a number for distance, range or count (mi, miles, km, ft, nautical, views, hours).

U049.function: Mixed: fires on commas in lists after a noun, on broken CJK bytes, and on mid-word pieces (Hot-ch, Tong-gu, Dao-ist).

U050.function: Fires on the unit after a number in a measurement (feet, metres, ft), and on mid-word pieces (touch-down, D-ool, Z-ay).

U051.function: Mixed: fires on later pieces of split rare names and words (Holy-o, Shuns-ai, Shū, Gans-u, surf) and on broken CJK bytes.

U052.function: Fires on middle or later pieces of split foreign or rare names (Z-aza, Ch-ou, Yaoc-hen, Giles, Indoch-ina).

U053.function: Mixed: fires on 'Fu' after 'Du', on 'which' after 'each of', and on mid-name fragments (Huff-ington, Ful-ham, Xuan, ph-ara-oh).

U054.function: Mixed: fires on 'Direction' after 'One', on 'long' in 'a long ...', and on mid-word fragments (G-id, un-happiness, arm-ament).

U055.function: Fires on the second @ in @-@ patterns (anti @-[[@]]) and on pieces of broken characters or rare words (casem-, truisms).

U056.function: Fires on the @ and first digit in the middle of numbers with comma or decimal markup (2 @,[[@]], ( [[4]]).

U057.function: Mixed: fires on the @ in numbers and hyphens (3 @.[[@]], all [[ @]]), on fragments like epit-het, ora-cles, and on 'all'.

U058.function: Mixed: fires on the @ in hyphen patterns and on assorted mid-sentence words and number pieces (form, now, 193[[0]], 10[[th]]).

U059.function: Mixed: fires on mid-name fragments (Ash-ik-aga, D-read, Hash-ira), on the @ in numbers (20 @,[[@]]), and on 'same'.

U060.function: Mixed: fires on the second word of a title or place name (Hall of Fame, Third Fleet, New York City, second studio, ninth studio) and on broken CJK bytes.

U061.function: Mixed: fires on later pieces of rare names (Ned-ler, Lemie-ux, Dread-n), and on function words like 'to' after 'unable/decided'.

U062.function: Fires on a trailing piece of a technical noun split into tokens (bulk-heads, catap-ult, war-head, mumm-ified, sph-inx).

U063.function: Mixed: fires on 'versions'/'version' after a modifier (US and UK versions, live version), and on later pieces of names (Bai Ju, Mein, Hotchk-iss, Ne-ith).

U064.function: Fires on the @ or hyphen symbol in @-@ patterns (anti @-@, scholar @-), and on the second = of heading markers.

U065.function: Fires on the last = in a heading marker, on the @ in decimals and hyphens, and on broken CJK or rare names (An L-ush-an).

U066.function: Mixed: fires on word-end pieces (Black-burn, touch-down, stra-ke, Tru-k), on 'of' in 'make use of', and on 'way' in 'make their way'.
